incident.distinction: The export failing coverage does not make the Definition artifact invalid. Representation PASS does not make the criterion admitted or the export complete.

evaluation_flow: Select exact Definition, inputs, profile revision and phase.
Report all 14 declared checks; preserve blockers.
For representation aggregate only 01/02/05: all scoped executed checks passed.
For pre-decision aggregate only 01-12: missing source/fidelity/formal/postimage/adoption evidence means not ready.
Keep owner selection/application checks pending; preparation does not fabricate them.
lifecycle_flow: A validated posture needs its complete adopted-profile validation gate and attributable transition.
Admitted needs exact owner selection and confirmed application.
rooted_distinction: The export coverage condition is false for the fixture; the Definition representation checks pass; the Definition lifecycle remains authored. These are distinct subjects and claims.
